# SWEEPR VPN & SWEEPR Wi-Fi Radar (sweeprvpn.com)

> SWEEPR VPN is an ultra-lightweight (<14 MB), native Rust + Tauri v2 WireGuard VPN and Home Wi-Fi Security Radar for Windows 10/11, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. Built by the team behind SWEEPR Cleaner, it combines 10Gbps RAM-only diskless WireGuard servers with a free local Wi-Fi & ISP throttling diagnostic scanner and an automated Smart-TV ACR screenshot telemetry blocker.

## Core Capabilities
- **10Gbps RAM-Only WireGuard & AmneziaWG Protocol**: Sub-5ms local peering in London, Manchester, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Zurich, New York, and Tokyo. Zero disk drives; volatile memory wiped on reboot.
- **Free Home Wi-Fi & ISP Throttling Diagnostic Scanner**: Scans local LAN (ARP/mDNS/SSDP) in 30 seconds to map 15–30+ connected household devices, flag unidentified Wi-Fi intruders, detect open router UPnP/Telnet vulnerabilities, and test for peak-hour ISP DNS throttling.
- **SWEEPR Wi-Fi Radar & Smart-TV Shield (Add-On / Complete Bundle)**:
  - Real-time desktop & mobile alerts whenever a new device joins the home Wi-Fi.
  - 1-click anti-throttling DNS optimization (encrypted DoH / WireGuard DNS) to stop peak-hour streaming buffering.
  - Automated DNS sinkholing of Smart-TV Automatic Content Recognition (ACR) screenshot telemetry across LG WebOS, Samsung Tizen, Roku, Vizio, and Fire TV.
- **Transparent Price-Lock Subscription Plans (No 400% Renewal Traps)**:
